description: This file defines a test implementation of an asset bundle used for testing purposes in a Flutter project. It extends the CachingAssetBundle class and provides methods to load assets either as ByteData or as String, serving hardcoded assets from in-memory data.

classes.name: TestAssetBundle
classes.description: A simple test implementation of CachingAssetBundle that serves hardcoded string assets for testing purposes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Overrides the load method to return ByteData for a given asset key, using in-memory data.

methods.name: loadString
methods.description: Overrides the loadString method to return the asset as a string for a given key, using in-memory data.
